title: Mayor, CMs Sworn In; New Pro Tem
summary:
*   **New Leadership Takes Office:** A special meeting was convened for the official swearing-in of the Mayor and three Councilmembers.
*   **Key Officials Sworn In:** Mayor Todd and Councilmembers Reynolds, Garcia, and Mitchell formally took their oaths of office.
*   **New Mayor Pro Tem Chosen:** Councilmember Nofziger was unanimously elected to serve as the Mayor Pro Tem.
